name: zerofailed
description: ZeroFailed's marketplace of Claude Code plugins and skills

plugins.name: zerofailed-tools
plugins.description: Tools for working with the ZeroFailed automation framework — includes author-zerofailed-extension for scaffolding and extending ZeroFailed extension modules, a reference skill for each ZeroFailed build/deploy extension (DevOps.Common, Build.Common/DotNet/PowerShell/Python/GitHub/Containers, Deploy.Common/Azure/PowerBI/Fabric) covering their properties, tasks and dependency chains, pluscicd-gha for wiring up the companion GitHub Actions reusable workflows
